Determine its SMILES notation carefully, using minimal but sufficient analysis." No experimental data provided. We have no spectra. We need to infer? Possibly the task expects us to use tools to get spectra of the sample at hand. The environment likely has a sample loaded; we can call mass_spectrometry_spectra, proton_nmr_spectra, carbon_nmr_spectra, ir_spectra, etc. We need to deduce structure.

We should start by measuring mass spectrum to get molecular weight. Use mass_spectrometry_spectra.
